name: Fall of the Ashen Warden
summary: Defeat Malakor, the Ashen Warden, at the far end of Floor 1.
startText: Malakor guards the exit portal of the Sunken Crypt. Rally a party and bring him down.
inProgressText: Malakor waits in the farthest chamber of the Sunken Crypt. Watch for his red ground slams.
completionText: The Sunken Crypt is ours! Ashen Keep salutes you, delver.
